sql.query: SELECT TOP (?) A.log_date, A.sum_uv, A.sum_pv,A.rnum,A.tot_cnt, isnull(b.memberCount,0) memberCount FROM ( select ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY yyyy,mm,dd ) AS rnum, count(*) over() tot_cnt, yyyy + RIGHT('00' + replace(mm, ' ', ''),2) + RIGHT('00' + replace(dd, ' ', ''),2) as reg_date, yyyy + '-' + RIGHT('00' + replace(mm, ' ', ''),2) + '-' + RIGHT('00' + replace(dd, ' ', ''),2) as log_date, sum(uv) as sum_uv, sum(pv) as sum_pv from tb_kabm_stat_view where yyyy + RIGHT('00' + replace(mm, ' ', ''),2) + RIGHT('00' + replace(dd, ' ', ''),2) >= ? and yyyy + RIGHT('00' + replace(mm, ' ', ''),2) + RIGHT('00' + replace(dd, ' ', ''),2) <= ? group by yyyy, mm, dd ) A left outer join ( select CONVERT(CHAR(8), reg_date, 112) as reg_date, count(*) as memberCount from TB_CYBER_MEMBER where CONVERT(CHAR(8), reg_date, 112) >= ? and CONVERT(CHAR(8), reg_date, 112) <= ? group by CONVERT(CHAR(8), reg_date, 112) ) B on A.reg_date = B.reg_date WHERE rnum > (?-1) * ?

mapping.getProperty: log_date, sum_uv, sum_pv, rnum, tot_cnt, memberCount
